purpose: Fixed historical development cases; not confirmation selection or a new detector

visual_review.method: Read all three existing grids with view_image; reviewed displayed samples only, not complete movies
visual_review.limitations: Historical equalized/resized grids; native details, exact body-ground clearance and continuous motion are not established

cases.normalized_name: 采样画面中躯干由倾斜转为倒置
cases.visible_description: 390–414的显示样本中躯干倾斜逐渐改变，418–425的显示样本中躯干倒置、腿朝上。
not_established: 绕身体哪根轴的精确角位移
cases.known_numeric_relation: tilt与up_z<0支持测量级姿态变化，不单独定义或证明后翻；当前同域成功对照少于3，残差必须保留comparison_missing。
cases.promotion_disposition: retain_visual_candidate; no numeric rollover definition or promotion

cases.normalized_name: 采样画面中低躯干姿态伴腿形变化
cases.visible_description: 显示样本中躯干较低，腿的屈伸轮廓改变；最后数格仍为低姿。
not_established: 腹部离台阶的精确高度或下沉幅度
接触力与首次碰撞时刻
cases.known_numeric_relation: 旧slip_any命中只表示受载参考点运动；当前四项签名为空、同域6成功中4个也为空，实际规则阴性。禁触终局不能补造腹部接触几何。
cases.promotion_disposition: retain_visual_candidate; surface-relative belly geometry and synchronized provenance unavailable

cases.normalized_name: 后段离散样本中躯干与腿形近似重复
cases.visible_description: 180、250、330、410、500、587步的显示格中，躯干与腿形近似重复；早段形态不同。
not_established: 未显示间隔内连续冻结
逐脚具体支撑面或无打滑
cases.known_numeric_relation: 旧low_progress已命中；当前加入RR_foot同体无载低运动且规则阳性。root低进展和单脚低运动不能扩大为全身冻结。
